finding.claim: Stored client_secret (client_credentials grant) and refresh_token (refresh path) are sent to an authorization server chosen by the MCP server's 401 WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata, with only scheme checks and no pinning of the AS to the configured server or the issuing AS.
finding.source: lib/mcp/client/http.rb:216-224 (401 from MCP endpoint); http.rb:465-470 parses resource_metadata verbatim; http.rb:406-421 and 472-481 pass it into the flow
finding.sink: lib/mcp/client/oauth/flow.rb:674-711 post_to_token_endpoint (Basic auth header at 693-697, POST to attacker token_endpoint at 700-711); flow.rb:178-183 exchange_refresh_token carries refresh_token

trace.note: attempt_refresh runs first when a refresh token exists
PRM fetched from attacker resource_metadata URL first
PRM authorization_servers[0] checked for scheme only
AS metadata issuer matches attacker-chosen issuer
client_secret placed in Basic Authorization header
refresh path: same unpinned AS discovery, then exchange_refresh_token at 178 sends refresh_token

finding.guards_checked: secure_url? scheme/loopback only (discovery.rb:181-194, flow.rb:380-385) does not bind host; canonical_resource (flow.rb:50, 513-525) passes when attacker PRM omits resource; issuer equality (flow.rb:261-263, 402-412) is self-consistent with attacker metadata; ensure_secure_endpoints (flow.rb:387-392) https only; no stored-issuer pinning found in flow.rb, provider.rb, storage_backed_provider.rb, client_credentials_provider.rb. Authorization-code path (flow.rb:58-94, 649-659) also leaks code_verifier and secret to attacker token endpoint after user consent at attacker AS (lower severity, same root cause).

finding.source: lib/mcp/client/http.rb:216-224 and WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata; flow.rb:237 authorization_servers entry
finding.sink: lib/mcp/client/oauth/flow.rb:764-766 http_get via flow.rb:208-214 and 297-300; POSTs at flow.rb:442-447 and 707
